decisions.reason: As a more distant but strategically relevant digital option that can support customer integration and information security, we would keep it for another year because uncertainty is still high and the cost of learning appears manageable.
This product fits our core cardboard solutions and the 2024 packaging award is a strong positive signal that justifies continued commitment rather than abandonment.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is close to our established offer, uses existing capabilities well, and should be kept while we gather another year of market evidence at limited additional risk.
The small counter display is a highly adjacent extension of our standard display business and is inexpensive to maintain in the portfolio while demand potential continues to reveal itself.

Although the large freestanding information display is close to our core business, its larger format likely brings somewhat higher commercialization and logistics uncertainty, so we keep it but monitor it more critically.
